senses.en: plan how something will look or work before making it

senses.zh: bản thiết kế; sự thiết kế
senses.en: the planning of something's appearance or function, or its plan
a decorative pattern on an object or surface

ex.en: My cousin designed a wooden desk for her bedroom.
Cities should design public spaces that encourage social interaction while remaining accessible to people with disabilities.

col: design a building｜thiết kế một tòa nhà
be designed to do something｜được thiết kế để làm gì
tip: be designed to do nghĩa là “nhằm mục đích làm gì”.

senses.en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour
quick to learn and understand things
promising success or showing happiness

ex.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.

tip: Ánh sáng mạnh dùng bright; căn phòng tối dùng dim.

senses.en: A person who manages workers or runs a business.
To order people around in an annoying or controlling way.

ex.en: My boss let me leave early for my appointment.
A supportive boss can improve employee satisfaction by offering constructive feedback and recognising individual contributions.

col: talk to your boss｜nói chuyện với sếp
a supportive boss｜một người sếp biết hỗ trợ
be your own boss｜làm chủ chính mình
tip: boss mang tính khẩu ngữ; làm động từ thường dùng boss someone around.

senses.en: A four-stringed instrument held under the chin and usually bowed.

ex.en: My sister practises the violin after dinner every evening.
Learning the violin can help children develop concentration, although regular lessons may be expensive for some families.

col: play the violin｜chơi đàn vĩ cầm
a violin concerto｜bản concerto cho vĩ cầm
tip: Người chơi vĩ cầm là violinist; nói chơi đàn thường dùng play the violin.

senses.en: speaking or behaving without respect for others

ex.en: It was rude to interrupt her during dinner.
Schools should teach children how to disagree respectfully without making rude comments about others.

col: rude to someone｜thô lỗ với ai
rude remark｜lời nói bất lịch sự
tip: Thô lỗ với ai dùng rude to someone, không dùng rude with.

senses.en: A hand covering with separate sections for fingers and thumb.

ex.en: I found my missing glove under the kitchen chair.
Healthcare workers should change disposable gloves between patients to reduce the risk of spreading infections.

col: a pair of gloves｜một đôi găng tay
disposable gloves｜găng tay dùng một lần
tip: Một đôi găng tay là a pair of gloves; chú ý gloves dùng số nhiều.

senses.en: to finish doing something or filling in information
having every necessary part, with nothing missing
total, without any limit or exception

ex.en: I completed the puzzle just before dinner was ready.
Students who complete vocational training often gain practical skills that help them enter the workforce more confidently.

col: complete a course｜hoàn thành một khóa học
complete a form｜điền xong biểu mẫu
a complete set｜một bộ đầy đủ
a complete success｜thành công trọn vẹn
tip: complete a form nghĩa là điền xong một biểu mẫu, không phải tạo ra biểu mẫu.

senses.en: to touch someone or something with your lips affectionately
an affectionate touch made with the lips

ex.en: She kissed her daughter gently before leaving for work.
In some cultures, a kiss on the cheek is a common greeting between close friends.

col: kiss someone goodbye｜hôn tạm biệt ai
give someone a kiss｜hôn ai một cái
a kiss on the cheek｜một nụ hôn lên má
tip: Hôn lên má ai dùng kiss someone on the cheek.

senses.zh: không gian; chỗ trống; khoảng cách
senses.en: Room available for something, or a gap between things

senses.zh: vũ trụ; không gian vũ trụ
senses.en: The vast area beyond Earth's atmosphere

senses.zh: xếp cách quãng; để khoảng cách
senses.en: To arrange things with gaps between them

ex.en: There is enough space for your bike beside mine.
Providing more green space in crowded neighbourhoods can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage outdoor physical activity.

tip: Khi chỉ không gian hay vũ trụ nói chung thì không đếm được; chỗ đỗ xe cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: To make the sounds of a word when speaking.
To state an official decision or judgment.

ex.en: Could you teach me how to pronounce your name?
Language learners often find unfamiliar sounds easier to pronounce after regular listening practice and feedback.

col: pronounce someone innocent｜tuyên bố ai vô tội
tip: Danh từ là pronunciation, chú ý ở giữa không có chữ o như trong pronounce.

senses.en: the skill or power needed to do something

ex.en: Her ability to fix bicycles impressed all her friends.
Regular reading can strengthen children's ability to understand complex ideas and express their own views clearly.

col: the ability to learn｜khả năng học tập
develop an ability｜phát triển một năng lực
tip: “Khả năng làm gì” dùng ability to do.

senses.zh: máy ghi âm; thiết bị ghi
senses.en: a device that captures sound, images, or information
a wooden or plastic wind instrument with finger holes
a person who keeps an official record

ex.en: I placed the recorder beside her before the interview.
Using a digital recorder allows researchers to review interviews carefully and identify recurring themes.

col: digital recorder｜máy ghi âm kỹ thuật số
tip: play the recorder nghĩa là thổi sáo dọc, không phải bật máy ghi âm.

senses.en: following the length or direction of something
forward from one place towards another
with someone when they go somewhere

ex.en: We walked along the river and watched the ducks.
Planting trees along busy roads can provide shade for pedestrians and improve the appearance of urban areas.

col: along the coast｜dọc theo bờ biển
bring someone along｜dẫn ai đi cùng
tip: along đi dọc theo chiều dài; across nhấn mạnh việc băng ngang từ bên này sang bên kia.

senses.zh: thưa bà; thưa quý bà (cách xưng hô lịch sự)
senses.en: A formal, polite way of addressing a woman.

ex.en: Would you like a table by the window, madam?
In formal customer service settings, staff may address a female customer as madam to show respect.

tip: Dùng khi xưng hô trang trọng với phụ nữ; trong giao tiếp thân quen hằng ngày thường không dùng.

senses.en: failed to catch, attend, or take advantage of something
failed to hit or notice someone or something
felt sad because someone or something was absent

ex.en: We missed the bus and walked home together.
Students who missed lessons due to illness should receive additional support to catch up with their classmates.

col: missed opportunity｜cơ hội bị bỏ lỡ
tip: Là quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ của miss; đuôi -ed đọc là /t/.

senses.en: A valuable yellow metal used for jewellery and money
The medal awarded for first place in a competition
Made of gold or having its yellow colour

ex.en: My grandmother keeps her gold ring in a wooden box.
Demand for gold can increase during economic uncertainty, as investors seek assets they consider relatively safe.

tip: Khi là tên chất liệu thì thường không đếm được; a gold có thể chỉ một huy chương vàng.

senses.en: the way a word or language is spoken

ex.en: I practise my pronunciation by recording short voice messages.
Clear pronunciation helps language learners communicate effectively, even when their grammar is not always accurate.

col: improve your pronunciation｜cải thiện phát âm
tip: Chú ý chính tả: pronunciation, ở giữa không có chữ o thứ hai như trong pronounce.

senses.zh: sự đào tạo; sự huấn luyện
senses.en: Learning and practice that develop skills for a particular activity.

senses.zh: sự luyện tập thể lực; sự huấn luyện thể thao
senses.en: Physical exercise and practice to prepare for sport.

ex.en: My first day of training involved helping customers.
Regular professional training helps employees adapt to technological changes and improves their long-term career prospects.

tip: Thường không đếm được; một buổi tập huấn có thể nói a training session.

senses.en: a thin, flat piece cut from something larger
to cut something into thin, flat pieces
a share or portion of something

ex.en: She put a slice of lemon in my tea.
Housing costs consume a large slice of household income, leaving many families with little money for leisure.

col: a slice of bread｜một lát bánh mì
a slice of the market｜một phần thị phần
tip: slice nhấn mạnh lát được cắt ra; piece chỉ chung một miếng hoặc một món.

senses.en: The food and drink someone regularly consumes.

senses.zh: chế độ ăn kiêng; thực đơn riêng
senses.en: A planned way of eating for health or weight control.
To control what you eat, usually to lose weight.

ex.en: My usual diet includes plenty of rice and vegetables.
A balanced diet can improve concentration and help students maintain their energy throughout the school day.

col: a balanced diet｜chế độ ăn cân bằng
a diet rich in fibre｜chế độ ăn giàu chất xơ
go on a diet｜bắt đầu ăn kiêng
tip: diet không nhất thiết là ăn kiêng, cũng có thể chỉ chế độ ăn hằng ngày.

senses.zh: thuộc Hà Lan; thuộc người Hà Lan
senses.en: Relating to the Netherlands, its people, or their language.
The language spoken in the Netherlands and parts of Belgium.
The people of the Netherlands, considered as a group.

ex.en: Our Dutch neighbour taught us how to bake apple pie.
Dutch cities are often studied by urban planners seeking to develop safer and more accessible cycling networks.

tip: Dutch viết hoa chữ cái đầu; the Dutch chỉ người Hà Lan nói chung.

senses.en: a smaller amount of something
to a smaller degree or extent
a smaller amount

ex.en: Please put less sugar in my tea this time.
Households can use less energy by improving insulation and choosing appliances that consume electricity more efficiently.

col: less likely｜ít có khả năng hơn
less and less｜càng ngày càng ít
no less than｜tới tận; không ít hơn
tip: Dùng less với danh từ không đếm được; danh từ đếm được số nhiều thường dùng fewer.

senses.en: A country's military force trained mainly to fight on land.
A large group of people working toward a shared purpose.

ex.en: My cousin joined the army after leaving school.
During major floods, the army can provide essential transport and supplies when civilian services are overwhelmed.

col: serve in the army｜phục vụ trong quân đội
an army of volunteers｜một đội quân tình nguyện viên
tip: army chủ yếu chỉ lục quân; armed forces chỉ chung các binh chủng.

senses.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.
Not working properly because of damage.
Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.

col: a broken promise｜lời hứa bị phá vỡ
tip: Cũng là quá khứ phân từ của break; quá khứ là broke.

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

ex.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.

tip: forest thường chỉ rừng lớn; wood có thể chỉ khu rừng nhỏ hơn.

senses.en: finely chopped meat enclosed in a thin, tube-shaped skin

ex.en: We grilled sausages and served them with fresh vegetables.
Consumers are increasingly choosing vegetarian sausages as they seek alternatives to traditional meat products.

col: sausage meat｜thịt xay làm xúc xích
tip: Một cây xúc xích đếm được; sausage meat chỉ thịt nhồi xúc xích, không đếm được.

senses.en: To plan and arrange an event or activity

senses.zh: sắp xếp; sắp đặt ngăn nắp
senses.en: To arrange things in a clear, useful order

ex.en: Our neighbours organized a picnic by the river.
Schools should organize practical workshops that help students develop communication skills and prepare for employment.

col: organize an event｜tổ chức một sự kiện
organize a meeting｜sắp xếp một cuộc họp
organize your time｜sắp xếp thời gian hợp lý
tip: Anh-Anh cũng thường viết organise; organize là cách viết phổ biến.

senses.en: an animal like a small horse with long ears

ex.en: A grey donkey carried baskets along the narrow mountain path.
In some rural communities, donkeys remain important for transporting goods where roads are unsuitable for vehicles.

tip: Với nghĩa con vật thì donkey được dùng nhiều; dùng để gọi người thì mang nghĩa chê bai.

senses.en: living or growing naturally, without human care
showing strong excitement or uncontrolled behaviour
natural places where animals and plants live freely

ex.en: We spotted wild deer drinking beside the forest stream.
Protecting wild animals requires governments to preserve habitats and reduce illegal trade across national borders.

tip: Để nói “ngoài tự nhiên” dùng in the wild, không được bỏ the.

senses.en: relating to society and how people live together
relating to meeting people and spending time with them
living naturally in organised groups rather than alone

ex.en: My new job leaves little time for social activities.
Affordable housing policies can reduce social inequality by helping families access safe homes near essential services.

col: social inequality｜bất bình đẳng xã hội
tip: social nghĩa là thuộc xã hội hoặc giao tiếp; sociable chỉ người dễ hòa đồng.

senses.en: An opening through something or a hollow space in the ground.
A weakness or missing part in a plan or argument.

ex.en: There's a small hole in my favourite sock.
The discovery of a hole in the safety fence prompted residents to request urgent repairs.

col: a hole in the ground｜một cái hố trên mặt đất
pick holes in｜bới lông tìm vết
tip: hole nghĩa là cái lỗ; whole nghĩa là toàn bộ; hai từ đồng âm.

senses.en: The currency used by many countries in the European Union.

ex.en: I found a euro in my coat pocket today.
Using the euro allows tourists to visit several European countries without exchanging money at each border.

col: the euro area｜khu vực đồng euro
pay in euros｜thanh toán bằng euro
adopt the euro｜áp dụng đồng euro
tip: Trong tiếng Anh thông thường số nhiều thường là euros; không phải nước EU nào cũng dùng euro.

senses.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.

ex.en: She keeps her favourite novels in a wooden bookcase.
Placing accessible bookcases in classrooms can encourage children to read independently during their free time.

col: a bookcase full of books｜tủ sách đầy sách
tip: bookcase là cả cái tủ sách; bookshelf là kệ sách hoặc một tầng ngăn.

senses.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required

senses.zh: sự cai trị; sự thống trị
senses.en: control of a country or people by a leader or group
to govern a country or make an official legal decision

ex.en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.

col: follow the rules｜tuân thủ quy tắc
break a rule｜vi phạm quy định
tip: as a rule nghĩa là “thường thì”; rule out nghĩa là “loại trừ”.

senses.en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair
to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush
to touch something lightly while moving past it

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
Children should learn to brush their teeth properly, as good habits can prevent many dental problems.

col: a paint brush｜cọ vẽ; chổi sơn
tip: brush against nghĩa là lướt nhẹ qua; brush up on nghĩa là ôn lại.

senses.en: Feeling pleased about achievements or people you care about.
Believing you are better or more important than others.

ex.en: He felt proud of the cake he baked himself.
Residents are often proud of their cultural heritage and support efforts to preserve historic buildings.

col: make someone proud｜khiến ai tự hào
too proud to ask｜quá sĩ diện để hỏi
tip: be proud of theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ, nghĩa là tự hào về điều gì.

senses.en: Easy to understand or do; not complicated.
Plain and without unnecessary decoration or extra features.

ex.en: This simple recipe takes just ten minutes to prepare.
Schools should provide simple instructions so that all students can complete classroom tasks independently.

col: keep it simple｜giữ cho đơn giản
tip: simple có thể nghĩa là dễ hoặc giản dị, không nhất thiết là sơ sài.

senses.en: Up to now, especially in questions and negative statements.
But, despite what has just been stated.
Used to emphasize a further increase or addition.

ex.en: I haven't finished dinner yet, so please wait.
Renewable energy is becoming cheaper, yet many countries still depend heavily on fossil fuels.

col: have yet to do｜vẫn chưa làm
tip: Nghĩa “vẫn chưa” thường đứng ở cuối câu phủ định; trong câu hỏi có thể nghĩa là “đã chưa”.

senses.en: decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings and necklaces

ex.en: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
Consumers increasingly want assurance that the materials used in jewelry are sourced responsibly and without environmental damage.

col: a piece of jewelry｜một món trang sức
tip: Đây là cách viết Anh-Mỹ, Anh-Anh viết jewellery; không đếm được, dùng piece để đếm.

senses.en: The amount of space between two places or things

senses.zh: sự xa cách; sự cách biệt
senses.en: A lack of emotional closeness between people

senses.zh: tách mình ra; phân định ranh giới
senses.en: To separate yourself from someone, something, or their views

ex.en: The distance from our house to school is quite short.
Reducing the distance between residential areas and workplaces could lower transport emissions and improve urban quality of life.

col: walking distance｜khoảng cách đi bộ được
distance yourself from｜phân định ranh giới với
tip: in the distance nghĩa là ở phía xa; at a distance nghĩa là cách một khoảng.

senses.en: Below the ground, or operating secretly.

senses.zh: ở dưới đất; một cách bí mật
senses.en: Below the ground, or in a hidden, secret way.
A railway system running mainly beneath a city.

ex.en: We left our car in an underground garage.
Underground transport systems can ease congestion, although constructing tunnels requires substantial investment and careful planning.

col: underground car park｜bãi đỗ xe ngầm
tip: Nghĩa “tàu điện ngầm” chủ yếu dùng trong Anh-Anh, trọng âm ở âm tiết đầu.

senses.en: to say that you will not do or accept something
unwanted waste material that people throw away

ex.en: She refused to leave without her favourite blue umbrella.
Local authorities may refuse permission for developments that threaten wildlife habitats or increase flood risks.

col: refuse to do something｜từ chối làm gì
refuse an offer｜từ chối lời đề nghị
tip: Danh từ đọc /ˈrefjuːs/ (trọng âm đầu); động từ theo sau là to do, không theo sau là doing.

senses.zh: lười biếng; không muốn cố gắng
senses.en: unwilling to work or make an effort
relaxed and involving little activity

ex.en: I felt too lazy to cook dinner tonight.
Students who struggle with homework should not automatically be considered lazy, as learning difficulties may be involved.

col: too lazy to｜lười đến mức không muốn
a lazy afternoon｜một buổi chiều nhàn nhã
tip: lazy afternoon là buổi chiều thư thả, không nhất thiết mang nghĩa chê.

senses.en: Making someone feel afraid or nervous.

ex.en: That scary noise was just a branch against the window.
Starting school can be scary for young children, so teachers should create a welcoming environment.

tip: scary diễn tả điều khiến người ta sợ; scared diễn tả người cảm thấy sợ.

senses.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: Her grandson visits every Sunday and helps with cooking.
Regular contact with a grandson or granddaughter can help older adults feel more socially connected.

tip: Không phân biệt bên nội hay ngoại; vừa là cháu nội vừa là cháu ngoại trai.

senses.zh: bất cứ đâu; ở đâu cũng
senses.en: in or to any place

senses.zh: ở nơi nào đó (trong câu hỏi và phủ định)
senses.en: in any place, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: You can sit anywhere you like in this room.
Reliable internet access allows employees to work from anywhere, reducing the need for daily commuting.

col: anywhere else｜bất cứ nơi nào khác
hardly anywhere｜hầu như không đâu cả
tip: Là trạng từ bất định, thường không làm danh từ; anywhere else nghĩa là ở nơi nào khác.

senses.en: a cloth symbol representing a country, group, or organisation

senses.zh: đánh dấu; gắn cờ; nhắc chú ý
senses.en: to mark something as needing attention
to become weaker or less energetic

ex.en: A bright flag fluttered above the school gate.
Teachers should flag potential learning difficulties early so that students can receive appropriate support.

col: flag an issue｜đánh dấu một vấn đề
flagging energy｜sức lực suy giảm dần
tip: Quá khứ flagged, tiếp diễn flagging, gấp đôi chữ g.

senses.en: To become someone's husband or wife.
To perform the ceremony that makes two people legally married.

ex.en: My cousin plans to marry her partner next spring.
Many young adults choose to marry later because they want financial stability before starting a family.

tip: Nói marry someone hoặc get married to, không nói marry with.

senses.en: Coming after sixth and before eighth in an ordered sequence.
One of seven equal parts of something.

ex.en: Our new flat is on the seventh floor.
By the seventh week of the course, students were able to analyse basic scientific data independently.

col: a seventh of｜một phần bảy của
tip: Số thứ tự thường có the đứng trước; không dùng the khi đã có từ sở hữu như my, his.

senses.en: existing in nature rather than made by people
having an ability from birth rather than through training
normal and expected in a particular situation

ex.en: This soap is made entirely from natural ingredients.
Protecting natural habitats is essential for maintaining biodiversity and supporting communities that depend on local ecosystems.

col: natural habitat｜môi trường sống tự nhiên
tip: natural nghĩa là tự nhiên (tính từ); nature là danh từ chỉ thiên nhiên.

senses.zh: nghề làm vườn; việc trồng cây cảnh
senses.en: The activity of growing and caring for plants in gardens.

ex.en: My grandmother enjoys gardening on cool spring mornings.
Community gardening can improve urban environments while helping residents develop stronger social connections.

col: do some gardening｜làm vườn một chút
tip: Thường là danh từ không đếm được: do some gardening.

senses.en: The sport of riding waves while standing on a board.
The activity of browsing websites on the internet.

ex.en: We went surfing at the beach early this morning.
The growing popularity of surfing can support coastal economies while increasing pressure on fragile marine environments.

tip: Môn thể thao dùng go surfing; lướt web cũng có thể nói surf the internet.

senses.en: A person who uses a product, service, or facility.

ex.en: Each user can choose a different colour for their profile.
Software developers should consider the needs of every user, including people with limited technical skills.

col: user feedback｜phản hồi của người dùng
road user｜người tham gia giao thông
tip: Chữ s trong use (động từ) và user đều đọc /z/.

senses.zh: tàu điện ngầm; hệ thống tàu điện ngầm
senses.en: An urban railway system that often runs underground.

ex.en: We took the metro to the museum this morning.
Expanding the metro could reduce traffic congestion by providing residents with a reliable alternative to private cars.

col: take the metro｜đi tàu điện ngầm
metro network｜mạng lưới tàu điện ngầm
tip: metro không chỉ có ở Pháp; đi tàu điện ngầm thường nói take the metro.

senses.en: To prevent someone or something from being harmed or lost.
To use less of something or keep money for later.
To keep something for future use, especially computer data.

ex.en: The lifeguard saved a child from the deep water.
Investing in reliable public transport can save commuters time and reduce household travel costs.

col: save a life｜cứu một mạng người
save money｜tiết kiệm tiền; để dành tiền
tip: save money có thể nghĩa là tiết kiệm hoặc gửi tiền để dành.

senses.en: Decorative objects worn on the body, such as rings and necklaces.

ex.en: She keeps her jewellery in a small wooden box.
Traditional jewellery can reflect cultural identity while providing income for skilled craftspeople in rural communities.

col: a piece of jewellery｜một món trang sức
tip: Không đếm được; một món dùng a piece of; Anh-Mỹ viết jewelry.

senses.en: a lightweight manufactured material that can form many different shapes
made of plastic
able to be shaped or changed easily

ex.en: This lunch box is made of strong recycled plastic.
Reducing single-use plastic packaging could protect marine ecosystems and lower the costs of managing household waste.

tip: Khi chỉ vật liệu nhựa thì thường không đếm được; a plastic chỉ một loại nhựa.

senses.en: In the direction of someone or something.
In relation to someone or something, especially in attitude.
Helping to achieve a goal or pay for something.

ex.en: The puppy ran towards me with its tail wagging.
Investment in public transport is an important step towards reducing air pollution in cities.

col: work towards a goal｜nỗ lực hướng tới mục tiêu
go towards the cost｜đóng góp một phần chi phí
tip: towards và toward có nghĩa như nhau; towards phổ biến hơn trong Anh-Anh.

senses.zh: súp lơ xanh; bông cải xanh
senses.en: A green vegetable with thick stems and tightly clustered flower buds.

ex.en: We steamed the broccoli until it turned bright green.
Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving vegetables such as broccoli alongside familiar dishes.

col: broccoli florets｜những nhánh bông cải xanh
a head of broccoli｜một cây bông cải xanh
tip: Thường không đếm được; nhánh nhỏ gọi là broccoli florets.

senses.en: To keep someone or something safe from harm or damage

ex.en: Wear thick gloves to protect your hands from thorns.
Governments should protect endangered species by preserving natural habitats and restricting activities that threaten their survival.

col: protect the environment｜bảo vệ môi trường
protect from harm｜bảo vệ khỏi tổn hại
protect privacy｜bảo vệ quyền riêng tư
tip: Thường dùng protect sb/sth from hoặc against, nghĩa là bảo vệ khỏi điều gì.

senses.en: Unusual or unexpected in a way that seems surprising
Not known or experienced before

ex.en: There was a strange noise coming from the cupboard.
Customs that seem strange to visitors may reflect important social values within the local community.

col: feel strange｜cảm thấy không thoải mái
a strange place｜một nơi xa lạ
a strange noise｜một tiếng động lạ
tip: strange vừa có nghĩa kỳ lạ vừa có nghĩa xa lạ; stranger là người lạ.

senses.en: Most recent or newest.

senses.zh: tin mới nhất; điều mới nhất
senses.en: The most recent news, developments, or products.

ex.en: Have you heard the latest news about our neighbour?
The latest research suggests that regular physical activity can improve both memory and mental health.

col: the latest research｜nghiên cứu mới nhất
the latest version｜phiên bản mới nhất
tip: latest nhấn mạnh mới nhất; last thường là cái trước hoặc cuối cùng.

senses.en: a long reptile without legs
to move or extend along a winding path

ex.en: A small snake slid quietly through the dry grass.
Although snakes often cause fear, they help maintain ecological balance by controlling populations of rodents and other animals.

tip: Làm động từ nghĩa là uốn lượn, thường đi với through hoặc along.

senses.en: a tall cupboard used for storing clothes

senses.zh: toàn bộ quần áo của ai
senses.en: all the clothes that a person owns

ex.en: Her winter coats fill most of the wardrobe.
Building a smaller wardrobe with durable clothing can reduce the environmental impact of fashion consumption.

col: fitted wardrobe｜tủ quần áo âm tường
capsule wardrobe｜tủ đồ tối giản dễ phối
update your wardrobe｜bổ sung quần áo mới
tip: Vừa chỉ cái tủ quần áo, vừa chỉ toàn bộ quần áo của một người.

senses.en: The town or city where you grew up or come from.

ex.en: I return to my hometown every summer to visit relatives.
Many graduates leave their hometown to seek better employment opportunities in larger urban centres.

col: return to your hometown｜trở về quê
tip: Có thể là thị trấn hoặc thành phố, không nhất thiết là nơi sinh.

senses.en: intelligent or showing good judgment

senses.zh: gọn gàng; lịch sự; sành điệu
senses.en: neat, stylish, and suitable for a formal occasion
using computer technology to perform tasks automatically

ex.en: That was a smart way to fix the shelf.
Smart irrigation systems can reduce water waste by adjusting supply according to soil conditions.

col: a smart choice｜một lựa chọn khôn ngoan
look smart｜trông gọn gàng lịch sự
tip: Anh-Anh thường dùng smart để nói về ăn mặc gọn gàng, thời trang; Anh-Mỹ thường dùng với nghĩa thông minh.

senses.en: the mother of your husband or wife

ex.en: My mother-in-law taught me how to grow tomatoes.
Support from a mother-in-law can reduce childcare costs and allow parents to continue their education.

col: future mother-in-law｜mẹ chồng/mẹ vợ tương lai
supportive mother-in-law｜mẹ chồng/mẹ vợ biết hỗ trợ
tip: Chỉ mẹ của người phối ngẫu; số nhiều là mothers-in-law.

senses.en: A hoofed animal, often with horns, kept for milk or meat.

ex.en: A curious goat poked its head through the fence.
Raising goats can provide rural families with a reliable source of milk and additional income.

col: a herd of goats｜một đàn dê
tip: goat là dê, sheep là cừu; “vật tế thần” dùng scapegoat.

senses.en: Easy to understand, see, or hear
Free from cloud, dirt, or anything blocking light
To remove unwanted things from a place

ex.en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
Public health campaigns should provide clear advice that people from different educational backgrounds can easily understand.

col: crystal clear｜trong suốt; rất rõ ràng
tip: make it clear that... nghĩa là nói rõ rằng...

senses.en: A website or page with regularly added posts.
To write and publish posts on a blog.

ex.en: She writes a blog about growing vegetables at home.
A well-researched blog can make scientific information more accessible to readers without specialist knowledge.

col: blog about something｜viết blog về điều gì
tip: Một bài đăng gọi là a blog post; blog thường chỉ cả trang blog.

senses.en: using electronic systems that store and process information as digits

ex.en: She keeps digital copies of all her family photos.
Improving digital skills can help older adults access public services and maintain contact with distant relatives.

col: digital camera｜máy ảnh kỹ thuật số
tip: digital nhấn mạnh công nghệ số; muốn nói “thuộc về con số” dùng numerical.

senses.en: Showing respect and consideration for other people.

ex.en: The polite child held the door open for us.
Polite communication in the workplace can reduce misunderstandings and help employees build stronger professional relationships.

col: polite to someone｜lịch sự với ai
polite request｜lời đề nghị lịch sự
polite conversation｜cuộc trò chuyện xã giao
tip: Lịch sự với ai dùng be polite to, không dùng polite with.

senses.en: The strength and enthusiasm needed for physical or mental activity
Power used to produce heat, movement, light, or electricity

ex.en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
Investing in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels while creating new employment opportunities.

col: full of energy｜tràn đầy năng lượng
energy consumption｜mức tiêu thụ năng lượng
tip: Khi chỉ sức lực hoặc năng lượng thì thường không đếm được, không nói an energy.

senses.en: the group of people officially controlling a country or region
the activity or system of controlling a country

ex.en: The government plans to build a new hospital nearby.
Local government plays a crucial role in providing affordable housing and maintaining essential public services.

col: government policy｜chính sách của chính phủ
a system of government｜một thể chế chính trị
tip: Trong Anh-Anh, khi chỉ nhóm người của chính phủ có thể đi với động từ số ít hoặc số nhiều.

senses.en: plan and arrange an event or activity

senses.zh: sắp xếp; sắp đặt ngăn nắp
senses.en: put things into a clear and useful order

ex.en: We organise a picnic for our neighbours every summer.
Local councils can organise community workshops to teach residents practical ways to reduce household waste.

col: organise an event｜tổ chức một sự kiện
organise a meeting｜tổ chức một cuộc họp
organise your time｜sắp xếp thời gian
tip: organise thường gặp trong Anh-Anh; Anh-Mỹ thường viết organize.

senses.zh: một cách đúng đắn; chính xác
senses.en: in a way that is accurate or follows the rules

ex.en: Check that you have entered your address correctly.
Students need regular feedback to ensure that they apply newly learned scientific concepts correctly in practical situations.

col: if I remember correctly｜nếu tôi nhớ không nhầm
tip: Bổ nghĩa cho hành động; correct là tính từ hoặc động từ, không dùng như trạng từ.

senses.en: treating people equally or reasonably
having pale skin or light hair
an event where people display or sell goods and services

ex.en: We took turns choosing games to keep things fair.
A fair education system should give every child access to quality teaching, regardless of family income.

tip: fair chỉ sự công bằng; fairly còn có thể nghĩa là “khá”.

senses.en: time away from work or study for rest or travel
to spend a holiday somewhere away from home

ex.en: We spent our summer vacation camping beside a lake.
Taking a regular vacation may improve employees' mental health and help them return to work with greater motivation.

tip: Chủ yếu dùng trong Anh-Mỹ; Anh-Anh thường dùng holiday.

senses.zh: du khách; người đi du lịch
senses.en: a person who travels from one place to another

ex.en: A tired traveler asked me where the station was.
Every traveler can support local communities by choosing accommodation and services owned by residents.

col: solo traveler｜du khách đi một mình
frequent traveler｜người hay đi du lịch
tip: traveler là cách viết Anh-Mỹ; Anh-Anh thường viết traveller.

senses.en: An object used to build, repair, or make things.

senses.zh: phương tiện; công cụ hỗ trợ
senses.en: Something that helps you perform a task or achieve something.

ex.en: This small tool helps me tighten the loose screws.
Digital maps are a valuable tool for urban planners seeking to design more accessible public transport networks.

col: a useful tool｜một công cụ hữu ích
a tool for learning｜công cụ học tập
tip: tool là danh từ đếm được; equipment thường không đếm được.

senses.en: the joint connecting your foot to your leg

ex.en: She twisted her ankle while walking down the steps.
Appropriate footwear can reduce the risk of ankle injuries during physical exercise and outdoor activities.

col: sprain an ankle｜bị bong gân mắt cá
a swollen ankle｜mắt cá chân sưng
ankle support｜đai hỗ trợ cổ chân
tip: ankle là chỗ nối giữa bàn chân và cẳng chân, không phải gót chân (heel).

senses.en: a breakfast food made from grains, often eaten with milk
a plant grown for grain, or the grain it produces

ex.en: She poured cold milk over her bowl of cereal.
Farmers may need to grow different cereal crops as changing rainfall patterns affect agricultural production.

col: a bowl of cereal｜một bát ngũ cốc
tip: Khi nói chung về món ăn sáng thì thường không đếm được; chỉ các loại ngũ cốc dùng cereals.

senses.en: A small animal with six legs and three main body sections.

ex.en: A tiny green insect landed on my sleeve.
Many insect species pollinate crops, making their protection essential for food production and healthy ecosystems.

tip: Danh từ đếm được; nhện có tám chân nên không phải côn trùng.

senses.en: a man who is French

ex.en: A Frenchman on the train helped me lift my suitcase.
The exhibition explores how a Frenchman adapted to life abroad while maintaining connections with his home culture.

col: a young Frenchman｜một chàng trai Pháp
a native Frenchman｜một người Pháp bản địa
tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu, số nhiều là Frenchmen; không phân biệt giới dùng French person.

senses.en: A person responsible for running a business, team, or department.

ex.en: The manager helped a new employee arrange the shelves.
An effective manager encourages open communication and ensures that employees have sufficient resources to complete their tasks.

tip: manager chỉ người quản lý; management có thể chỉ công tác quản lý hoặc ban quản lý.

senses.en: without anyone else present
without other people or their help
only, excluding everything or everyone else

ex.en: I was alone in the kitchen when the kettle boiled.
Governments cannot solve environmental problems alone, as lasting progress also requires cooperation from businesses and individual citizens.

col: travel alone｜đi du lịch một mình
go it alone｜tự mình làm lấy
tip: alone nghĩa là một mình, không nhất thiết cô đơn; lonely nhấn mạnh cảm giác cô đơn.

senses.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.

col: competition for jobs｜cạnh tranh việc làm
enter a competition｜tham gia cuộc thi
win a competition｜giành chiến thắng trong cuộc thi
tip: Sự cạnh tranh thường không đếm được; một cuộc thi thì đếm được.

senses.en: meat from cattle, eaten as food

ex.en: We cooked the beef slowly with carrots and potatoes.
Reducing beef consumption could lower greenhouse gas emissions because raising cattle requires substantial land and resources.

tip: Khi chỉ thức ăn thì thường không đếm được: some beef, không dùng a beef.

senses.en: to talk about something and exchange ideas
to examine a subject in speech or writing

ex.en: Let's discuss our holiday plans over dinner tonight.
Students should discuss different solutions before deciding how to reduce waste on their campus.

col: discuss a problem｜thảo luận vấn đề
discuss something with someone｜thảo luận điều gì với ai
discuss in detail｜thảo luận chi tiết
tip: discuss đi thẳng với nội dung thảo luận: discuss sth, không thêm about.

senses.zh: đồ ăn nhẹ; món ăn vặt
senses.en: A small amount of food eaten between main meals.
To eat small amounts of food between main meals.

ex.en: I packed an apple and some nuts for a snack.
Schools can encourage healthier eating habits by offering nutritious snacks instead of foods high in sugar.

col: a healthy snack｜đồ ăn vặt lành mạnh
snack on nuts｜ăn hạt làm đồ ăn vặt
tip: Động từ thường dùng snack on sth, nghĩa là ăn vặt bằng món gì.

senses.en: A thick, usually tomato-based sauce served with food.

ex.en: He squeezed some ketchup onto his plate of chips.
Reducing added sugar in everyday products such as ketchup could help consumers make healthier dietary choices.

col: a bottle of ketchup｜một chai tương cà chua
a squeeze of ketchup｜một chút tương cà bóp ra
tip: Không đếm được; khác với tomato paste (cà chua cô đặc) dùng để nấu ăn.

senses.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised
someone or something that provides a good example to follow
a person who displays clothes or poses for artists

ex.en: He built a model of a bridge from cardboard.
Researchers use a computer model to predict how rising temperatures may affect regional water supplies.

tip: model còn có thể là động từ, nghĩa là xây dựng mô hình hoặc làm người mẫu.

senses.en: A machine that makes paper copies of documents or pictures.

ex.en: The office photocopier has run out of paper again.
Providing a shared photocopier allows small businesses to reduce equipment costs while meeting their daily printing needs.

tip: photocopier là cái máy; photocopy là bản sao hoặc hành động sao chụp.

senses.en: letters and parcels sent or delivered through a postal service

senses.zh: gửi thư; gửi qua bưu điện
senses.en: to send a letter or parcel through a postal service

ex.en: The mail arrived just as we finished breakfast.
Although digital communication is widespread, many rural residents still depend on mail for essential documents.

col: send by mail｜gửi qua đường bưu điện
mail a parcel｜gửi một bưu kiện
tip: Khi là “thư từ” thì thường không đếm được; Anh-Anh thường dùng thêm post.

senses.en: lacking physical strength or energy
not effective, convincing, or well supported
having little intensity, flavour, or power

ex.en: I felt too weak to carry the shopping upstairs.
Policies based on weak evidence may fail to address the underlying causes of unemployment.

tip: weak đồng âm với week; weakness có thể là điểm yếu hoặc sự yếu đuối.

senses.en: To design or make something that did not exist before.
To make up a story or excuse that is untrue.

ex.en: My sister invented a clever tool for picking apples.
Engineers must invent affordable technologies that help rural communities gain access to clean drinking water.

col: invent a device｜phát minh ra một thiết bị
invent an excuse｜bịa ra lý do
invent a story｜bịa ra một câu chuyện
tip: invent là tạo ra cái mới; discover là tìm ra cái vốn đã có.

senses.en: to find something or learn something previously unknown

ex.en: We discovered a quiet beach behind the cliffs.
Scientists may discover new ways to treat diseases by studying plants in tropical forests.

col: discover a cure｜tìm ra phương thuốc
discover a new species｜phát hiện loài mới
discover the truth｜khám phá ra sự thật
tip: discover là tìm ra cái đã tồn tại; invent là tạo ra cái mới.

senses.en: Someone who plans how something will look or work.

senses.zh: do nhà thiết kế nổi tiếng thiết kế; hàng hiệu
senses.en: Made by a famous fashion designer, usually expensive.

ex.en: The designer showed us a model of our kitchen.
A skilled designer can make public spaces more accessible to people with limited mobility.

col: fashion designer｜nhà thiết kế thời trang
graphic designer｜nhà thiết kế đồ họa
interior designer｜nhà thiết kế nội thất
tip: Làm tính từ thường đứng trước danh từ như quần áo, nhấn mạnh hàng hiệu của nhà thiết kế.

senses.en: a large sports venue with seating around a central area

ex.en: Fans filled the stadium before the football match began.
Building a new stadium may attract visitors, but its long-term maintenance costs require careful consideration.

col: packed stadium｜sân vận động kín chỗ
stadium capacity｜sức chứa của sân vận động
tip: Số nhiều có thể là stadiums hoặc stadia, dạng đầu phổ biến hơn.

senses.en: A child who attends school.
The dark opening in the eye that lets light enter.

ex.en: Each pupil brought a leaf to the science lesson.
Smaller classes may allow teachers to give each pupil more individual support and useful feedback.

col: primary school pupil｜học sinh tiểu học
tip: Trong Anh-Anh thường chỉ học sinh tiểu học và trung học; sinh viên đại học dùng student.
